app.title: Show HN: Galaxium, an experimental WebGPU space explorer
app.author: guillaumec
app.description: A WebGPU-powered interactive space explorer that renders a procedurally generated solar system in the browser.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install` followed by `npm run build`.
Serve the build locally and open in Chrome to ensure WebGPU initialization succeeds.
Navigate to a predefined planet and verify the 3D scene renders within 1 s.
Run a headless browser test to capture a screenshot and compare pixel accuracy against a baseline.
